entries.definition: Make a local copy of a remote repository.
entries.ste_example: Clone the repository to your local machine.
entries.non_ste_example: Grab a copy of the repo and pull it down locally.

entries.definition: Combine changes from one branch into another.
entries.ste_example: Merge the feature branch into main.
entries.non_ste_example: Squash all those commits into main when you're done.

entries.definition: Find a solution for a merge conflict or error.
entries.ste_example: Resolve the merge conflicts in the pull request.
entries.non_ste_example: Fix the merge mess in your PR.

entries.definition: Create a new instance of a class or object.
entries.ste_example: Instantiate the UserService with the database connection.
entries.non_ste_example: New up a UserService and wire it in.

entries.definition: Call a function, method, or API endpoint.
entries.ste_example: Invoke the callback function after the request completes.
entries.non_ste_example: Fire the callback when the request finishes.

entries.definition: Move through each element of a data structure.
entries.ste_example: Traverse the document tree to find all paragraph nodes.
entries.non_ste_example: Walk the DOM and grab all the p tags.

entries.definition: Convert an object into a format for storage or transmission.
entries.ste_example: Serialize the response body as JSON.
entries.non_ste_example: Stringify the response before sending it back.

entries.definition: Convert stored or transmitted data back into an object.
entries.ste_example: Deserialize the JSON payload into a User object.
entries.non_ste_example: Parse the incoming JSON into a User.

entries.definition: Move data or schema between environments or versions.
entries.ste_example: Migrate the database schema from version 2 to version 3.
entries.non_ste_example: Run the upgrade script to move your DB to v3.

entries.definition: Coordinate multiple services or steps in a workflow.
entries.ste_example: Orchestrate the deployment across three environments.
entries.non_ste_example: Manage the whole deploy pipeline across dev, staging, and prod.

entries.definition: Verify the identity of a user or service.
entries.ste_example: Authenticate the request using a bearer token.
entries.non_ste_example: Check the login credentials before letting them in.

entries.definition: Check that a user or service has permission for an action.
entries.ste_example: Authorize the user before allowing access to the admin endpoint.
entries.non_ste_example: Make sure they have the right role before hitting that admin route.

entries.definition: Limit the rate of requests or operations.
entries.ste_example: Throttle requests to 100 per minute per IP address.
entries.non_ste_example: Rate-limit the API so nobody hammers it.

entries.definition: Register to receive events or messages from a source.
entries.ste_example: Subscribe to the user-created event channel.
entries.non_ste_example: Listen for user creation events and hook into them.

entries.definition: Send an event or message to subscribers.
entries.ste_example: Publish a payment-processed event to the message queue.
entries.non_ste_example: Fire off a payment-done event to the queue.
